segments.title: Cold Open & TikTok Idea Collection
segments.notes: Pepito delivers sign-on; Case collects 168+ viewer-submitted TikTok concepts for a planned YouTube series where ideas are drawn from a hat and executed as 'perfect TikToks'.

segments.title: Moody's Downgrades U.S. Credit Rating
segments.notes: Case reads Moody's downgrade of U.S. sovereign rating from AAA to Aa1 citing $36T debt; riffs on FAAFO fiscal policy, pantyhose austerity, and the Heritage Foundation's Koch-adjacent outrage.

segments.title: Trailer Block: Alien Earth, Moog Guy, Americana, Straw, Ironheart
segments.notes: Case and Liliana react to five trailers: FX's Alien Earth (4.13★), horror film Moog Guy (3.71★), Tony Toast's Americana (2★), Tyler Perry's Straw (2.67★), Marvel's Ironheart series (3.13★).

segments.title: News Roundup: Metaverse Layoffs, Grok AI, Undersea Volcano, Diddy, Tiny Penis History, Haitian Empanada Vigilante, Kid Rock, Fortnite Vader AI, Trump Watch, Military Parade
segments.notes: Rapid-fire wire stories: Zuckerberg fires metaverse staff; Grok AI obsessed with South African 'kill the boer' chant; Axial Seamount eruption expected 2025; Sean Combs 'Tootsie Roll' allegation; historical penis-size trends; Haitian woman poisons 40 gang members with insecticide-laced empanadas; Kid Rock restaurant sends staff home ahead of ICE raid; Fortnite's AI Darth Vader tricked into swearing; Trump-branded watch missing 'T'; $25-45M military parade planned.

segments.title: Trip on the Street: Park Interviews
segments.notes: Trip Bradstein interviews park denizens: mustache man seeking kiss, empanada victim melting into quarter, tiny barbecue chef 'D', Bobby Yaga with pen-gun, Harry Swings windowless van pitch, Mountain Man Mike on Sasquatch-Viking war, Bonus Salad Viking fan, Tainted Empanada Steve, Jane Jetson vs Rosie debate, Don Riggles comedy bit, Chris Sawyer roller-coaster apology, park ranger sunscreen warning, dog 'Borf', Twisty coaster fantasy, Blarney Stone kiss demand, empanada woman simulation trap, Crown/Crum borrowing $500, Guard Reducted/Clementine, Kendall tea spill, Harold Wrong circus stonks rap, Hamtaro church donation, Munch hunting Crum in hoodie, Pappito blessing with crumpets, Mosey Moe flying.

segments.title: Amongst the Web with Darfus (Marfus Jarvifs Darfus)
segments.notes: Gorilla-named guest Darfus joins Case to rate internet videos: donut-eating horse (7.17★), Vogue Master music (unrated), Jason Rodelo anti-vaping CEO (unrated), hot dog water fountain (2.86★), Rockstar jiggle physics engineer Dan Carney (9.4★), glizzy overdrive NPC (unrated), one-legged breaker (10★), wrist-strength game (10★), flesh Coke cans (low).

episode_summary: Case Blackwell opens with a massive TikTok idea drive (168+ submissions) before covering Moody's historic downgrade of U.S. credit to Aa1. A five-trailer block follows, then a sprawling news roundup spanning Grok AI's South African fixation, an undersea volcano, a Haitian empanada vigilante killing 40 gang members, and a $45M Trump military parade. Trip Bradstein conducts a chaotic park interview gauntlet featuring Crum begging for gorilla-debt cash, Munch hunting him in a hoodie, and Pepito blessing the streets. The broadcast closes with gorilla-named guest Darfus co-hosting Amongst the Web, rating internet videos including a Rockstar jiggle-physics engineer (9.4★) and back-to-back 10★ breakdance clips.
